records.preparation: Prepare stock solution from the powder components; allow the freshly mixed solution to cool before use.

records.preparation: Dissolve packs 1, 2 and 3 sequentially in 750 ml distilled water at 55-60 C, then make up to 1 litre and cool to room temperature.

records.preparation: Dissolve pack 1 then pack 2 in 700-800 ml distilled water at 55-60 C; make up to one litre, cool, and allow 3-4 hours before use.

records.preparation: Mix one part B with one part A, then dilute with 100 parts distilled water for standard tank development; 1:1:200 may be used for stand development.

records.preparation: Dissolve pack 1 then pack 2 in 750 ml water at 48-50 C; make up to 1 litre and cool to 20-22 C.
records.reuseInstructions: Up to 10 rolls of 135 per litre without replenishment; increase processing time by 10% for each film after the first.
records.capacityText: Up to 10 rolls of 135 per litre.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Sealed powder packs: up to 12 months from production date.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Unused working solution: up to 6 months tightly sealed; partly used solution: up to 45 days, but do not store after more than half the capacity has been used.
